Use TRUE transparent RGBA alpha, no checkerboard or solid background. No labels, lettering, grid, cell outlines, scenery, floor, ground shadows, motion trails, detached effects, debris, projectiles, floating emblems or extra sprites. Every wing, tail, limb and held prop stays connected to its creature; no separated stone/leaf/feather islands.
